correctness.rationale: For all d>=2,n>=2d, the base B_d(C_2d) is the join of boundaries on alternating vertex classes and its rotation/reflection orientation signs are computed explicitly. A cyclic 0-1 contraction is simplicial because d independent target colors would lift to an independent source d-set. Adjacent swapped contractions are contiguous: a hypothetical forbidden independent d-set in the union would lift with the modified source vertex to a forbidden independent source d-set. All normalized contractions are homotopic, so rotations/reflections transport to the base via the published coloring homotopy equivalence (d>=3) or degree-one circle map (d=2). Equivariant inclusions transfer the representation to powers; rational chain averaging proves the quotient classification. Finite signed Lefschetz and swap-contiguity checks pass; no computation is substituted for the uniform proof.
